kind: Posthoc expanded-task sensitivity, never part of primary graders

import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';import {resolve} from 'node:path';const api=(await import(pathToFileURL(resolve(process.env.SUFFICE_WORKSPACE,'src/index.js')))).default;
test('posthoc expanded infinite-age contract',()=>{const real=Date.now;let now=100000;Date.now=()=>now;try{const q=new api({maxSize:20,maxAge:10});for(const age of [Infinity,-Infinity])q.set(String(age),1,{maxAge:age});now+=1000;for(const age of [Infinity,-Infinity])assert.equal(q.get(String(age)),1);}finally{Date.now=real;}});

import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {createRequire} from 'node:module';import {resolve} from 'node:path';const api=createRequire(resolve(process.env.SUFFICE_WORKSPACE,'src/package.json'))('./index.js');
test('posthoc expanded nested snapshot once contract',()=>{const q=new api(),trace=[];let recursed=false;q.on('x',()=>{trace.push('a');if(!recursed){recursed=true;q.emit('x');}});q.once('x',()=>trace.push('once'));q.on('x',()=>trace.push('b'));q.emit('x');assert.deepEqual(trace,['a','a','once','b','b']);});
